title: Conectores de registro formal: a lo largo de, en última instancia

sections.content: A lo largo de spans a period across which several things happened together; en última instancia closes an argument by naming what things came down to, beyond all the surface complications. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A lo largo de las primeras décadas republicanas, los nuevos países enfrentaron varios desafíos al mismo tiempo.
items.english: Throughout the first republican decades, the new countries faced several challenges at once.

items.spanish: A lo largo de todo este proceso coexistieron el fracaso evidente y un progreso mucho más silencioso.
items.english: Throughout this whole process, obvious failure and a much quieter progress coexisted.

items.spanish: En última instancia, ni siquiera la inestabilidad más severa impidió que se fueran acumulando las bases de un Estado moderno.
items.english: Ultimately, not even the severest instability stopped the foundations of a modern state from gradually building up.

items.spanish: En última instancia, estos primeros desafíos fueron el material bruto con el que cada país terminó construyendo instituciones capaces de perdurar.
items.english: Ultimately, these early challenges were the raw material each country eventually used to build lasting institutions.

sections.content: En última instancia is the closing move of a formal argument — it says "setting all the complications aside, here is what actually mattered in the end." Save it for the sentence that sums up a paragraph's real point, not for an ordinary consequence.
